title: US death row inmate Christa Pike awake and speaking after failed execution, lawyers say
description: Experts and lawyers called the apparent recovery unprecedented, noting she is believed to be the only known person to survive a lethal injection.

title: What we know about Christa Pike’s ‘unprecedented' recovery
description: The BBC's Sarah Smith details the injuries sustained by the US death row inmate after two failed lethal injections, and what comes next.

title: Residents of kibbutz destroyed in 7 October Hamas-led attacks grapple with how to rebuild
description: Three years on from the attack on Nir Oz, in which 47 people were killed and 76 taken hostage, some survivors have returned to live there.

title: Military training sites to be investigated following rape and abuse claims at Army college
description: In August, four young women told the BBC they were sexually assaulted and harassed at the school in Harrogate.

title: The Republican candidates walking a Trump tightrope
description: Some running in November's elections are deciding whether to distance themselves from an unpopular president who still dominates his party.

title: Jaguar unveils new electric car after 'woke' ridicule
description: Two years after JLR relaunched Jaguar into a blizzard of controversy, it has launched its new EV.

title: Watch: Police raid on gang behind fake gay asylum claims
description: The arrests come after a BBC investigation in April revealed that law firms and advisers were helping migrants pose as gay in an effort to get asylum.

title: New global guidelines warn against obesity drugs for children under 10
description: Care should focus on healthy eating and exercise, not medicines such as weight-loss injections, says the World Health Organization

title: Man charged with murder after GP found dead at her home
description: A man is charged with the murder of a GP who was found dead at her home.
